title: UCLA Campus Gathering, Students on Quad Lawn - Vintage 1960s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black-and-white snapshot developed in March 1966 depicting a large outdoor assembly or lecture on a university quad, reminiscent of the Romanesque Revival architecture found at UCLA. A crowd of students and faculty sits gathered around a podium and lawn area under an open sky, capturing the atmosphere of 1960s American campus life.
